topic: Mann Gulch fire (1949): foreman Wag Dodge set an escape fire as his crew fled the advancing wildfire

research_sources.institution: U.S. Forest Service Board of Review (1949)
focus: route towards the river was cut off
Dodge's decision, after contacting Harrison and rejoining his crew

research_cautions: The Board concluded the escape fire did not impede the crew; a relative argued otherwise. The Board found it inconclusive how many men understood Dodge's directions.
Do not portray the firefighters who died as ignoring a simple rescue instruction.
